errors.not_forward: A case can only move forward in its flow.
errors.not_failed: Only failed transfers can be retried.
errors.amount_required: Enter the amount for this resolution.

errors.percent_range: A percentage must be between 0 and 100.

warn.movementPermitBlock: This load crosses a provincial border and has no state-vet movement permit on file. It cannot be scheduled yet.
warn.birdFluBlock: The supplier is in a bird-flu surveillance zone. Nothing moves without state-vet permission, so this cannot be scheduled yet.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.subtitle: Today's trading, the pipeline and what needs you.

orders.title: Orders
orders.subtitle: Every order, across all buyers.
orders.emptyBody: Try another status tab or clear the filters.

bulk.cancelBody: {count} unpaid order(s) will be cancelled. Paid orders are skipped. This cannot be undone.

order.title: Order {number}
order.noAllocation: Assign a supplier first, then pick a driver.
order.moneyNote: Supplier price is per bird. Transfer fees are R3 per transfer plus VAT.

money.incomplete: No supplier assigned yet, so this margin is not final.

match.title: Supplier matching
match.assignBody: Assign {name} for {count} birds. The supplier will be offered the job.
match.refundWarning: The buyer will be refunded in full:

outcome.cheaper_keep_price: The new supplier is cheaper. The buyer keeps the price they paid and the extra margin is ours.
outcome.absorb: The new supplier costs more. McCluckin's absorbs the difference because margin stays at zero or above.
outcome.full_refund: The new supplier would push margin below zero, so the buyer gets a full refund.

schedule.title: Schedule
schedule.subtitle: Paid orders waiting for a date, and who is driving when.
schedule.buyerNote: The buyer is told on WhatsApp and email. Buyers never choose a time.
schedule.gridEmpty: Add active drivers and delivery slots to see the grid.
schedule.stockNone: No stock recorded for this week.

users.title: Users
users.subtitle: Approve pending accounts, review compliance documents, suspend or reactivate.

empty.pending: No accounts are waiting for approval.

users.activateBody: {name} will be able to log in and receive jobs.

review.title: Compliance review
review.pickBody: Choose Review on a supplier or driver to see their documents.
review.rejectBody: The {kind} will be marked rejected and the owner asked to upload it again.
review.note: Suppliers and drivers get no jobs until required documents are approved.

cases.title: Cases
cases.subtitle: Problems raised by buyers. First reply within 2 business hours.
cases.pickBody: Click a case to see evidence, counts and the timeline.
cases.advanceBody: This is recorded on the case timeline and cannot be undone.

payouts.title: Payouts
payouts.subtitle: Paystack transfers to suppliers and drivers.
payouts.paidTitle: Mark the payout to {name} as paid
payouts.paidBody: Pay them outside the app, then record it here. Amount:
payouts.proofRequired: Attach the proof of payment first.

payouts.statementsHelp: File each bank statement so every payment, payout and bank fee can be traced to a document.
payouts.retryBody: Paystack will try to pay {name} again:
payouts.bankNote: Bank file lists queued and failed transfers as a fallback if Paystack cannot pay them.

compliance.title: Compliance
compliance.subtitle: PDMA, documents, permits and bird-flu exposure.
compliance.permits: Removal permits expiring (birds leave within 36 hours)
compliance.permitsNone: No removal permits are close to expiry.
compliance.zonesNone: No suppliers are paused in a bird-flu zone.
compliance.crossingNone: No open trips cross a provincial border.

quotes.title: Quotes
quotes.subtitle: Quote requests from buyers. Price each one by choosing which suppliers fill it. The buyer is then able to see the price and place the order.
quotes.priceHelp: Share the {n} birds across suppliers. Supplier prices are only shown here, never to the buyer.
quotes.noSuppliers: There are no suppliers on the platform yet.
quotes.readyBody: {n} supplier(s) can fill this quote. Choose how many birds each one supplies.
quotes.blockedTitle: This quote cannot be priced yet
quotes.blockedIntro: No supplier passes every check. Chase the people below; the quote can be priced as soon as one supplier is clear.
quotes.noDriversAtAll: No driver has signed up yet.

driverIssue.no_capacity: Has not entered how many birds the vehicle carries

driverAsk.not_active: Hi {name}, your McCluckin's driver account is waiting for approval. Please finish uploading your documents under Get approved.
driverAsk.paused: Hi {name}, your McCluckin's driver account is paused. Please contact us so we can sort it out.
driverAsk.no_capacity: Hi {name}, please open McCluckin's, go to Get approved and fill in your vehicle details, including how many birds it carries. We cannot give you trips without it.

ask.not_active: Hi {name}, your McCluckin's supplier account is waiting for approval. Please finish uploading your documents under Get approved.
ask.paused: Hi {name}, your McCluckin's supplier account is paused. Please contact us so we can sort it out.
ask.no_location: Hi {name}, we have a buyer order for you but cannot match it yet. Please open McCluckin's, go to Get approved, and tap Use my location while you are at the farm gate.
ask.no_price: Hi {name}, please open McCluckin's, go to Prices and set your price per bird for this bird type and weight band.
ask.flu_zone: Hi {name}, your farm is in a bird flu zone. Please upload your state vet movement permit under Get approved.
ask.docs: Hi {name}, some of your compliance documents are missing, rejected or expired. Please check Get approved and upload them.
ask.stock: Hi {name}, please update your available birds for this week under Stock so we can offer you this order.

quotes.noneEligible: No supplier can fill this quote right now. The reason for each supplier is listed below.

reason.no_location: No farm gate location. The supplier must open Get approved and tap Use my location
reason.no_price: No active price for this bird type and weight band
reason.flu_zone: In a bird flu zone without an approved movement permit
reason.docs: Compliance documents are missing, rejected or expired
reason.stock: Not enough stock this week for the supplier's minimum order
reason.no_driver: No approved driver can meet this supplier's vehicle rules (a driver needs a capacity, and a covered vehicle if the supplier requires one)

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Pricing, limits, provinces, languages and messages. Every change is written to the audit log.
settings.newQuotesOnly: Applies to new quotes only. Existing quotes and orders keep the prices they were made at.
settings.timelineHelp: Leave blank while the delivery timeline is not set. A promise is added to buyer messages once known.
settings.mode_manual: Manual: buyer pays by EFT, admin marks it paid
settings.mode_paystack: Online: buyer pays by card through Paystack
settings.paymentsModeHelp: Online payments only work once the Paystack functions are deployed and the webhook is set.
settings.companyHelp: Printed on quotes, invoices and receipts. Bank details are shown to buyers on their order so they can pay by EFT.

error.percent_range: A percentage must be between 0 and 100.
error.out_of_range: The value is outside the allowed range.

settings.noSecrets: Only the mode is shown. API keys and secrets are never displayed here.
settings.langBody: Change whether {lang} is offered to users.
settings.templatesNone: No message templates are stored yet.

billing.notPayable: This order is not awaiting payment.

billing.bankFeeHelp: What the bank charged to receive it. Leave empty if there was no charge.
billing.feeInvalid: Enter the fee in rand, for example 12.50.
billing.buyerProofs: Proof of payment from the buyer
billing.noProofs: The buyer has not sent a slip yet.
